title: Model inventory
description: Maintain a central inventory of all models, including vendor models, with owner, use case and risk tier. Inventory is reconciled quarterly.

title: Model risk tiering
description: Each model is assigned a risk tier before production use based on customer impact, materiality and level of automation.

title: Independent model validation
description: High-risk models are validated by an independent validation team before first use and annually thereafter.

title: Model performance monitoring
description: Model owners monitor accuracy, drift and stability against thresholds. High-risk models are reviewed monthly.

title: Model change management
description: Material changes to a model are documented, tested and approved before release.

title: Vendor due diligence
description: Third-party vendors undergo due diligence before contract, covering financial condition, operations and data practices.

title: Vendor security assessment
description: Information security assessment of vendors that access systems or customer data, performed before contract and annually.

title: Contract standards
description: Vendor contracts include required clauses on data use, retention, onward transfer, audit rights and termination.

title: Vendor exit planning
description: Critical vendors have a documented exit strategy to replace or insource the service without material disruption.

title: Vendor performance reviews
description: Service levels of critical vendors are reviewed against contract terms twice a year.

title: Fair lending testing
description: Credit models are tested for disparate impact on protected classes before deployment and quarterly while in use.

title: Adverse action notices
description: Applicants receiving an adverse credit decision are given a notice with the specific principal reasons.

title: Customer data sharing approval
description: Sharing customer personal information with third parties requires privacy review and a data sharing agreement.

title: Privacy notices
description: Customer privacy notices are reviewed annually and updated when data practices change.

title: Operational incident escalation
description: Material operational incidents are escalated to senior management within five business days and summarized to the board quarterly.

title: Cyber incident response
description: Security incidents follow the cyber incident response plan, including regulator notification timelines.

title: Records retention
description: Business records, including model documentation and validation reports, are retained for at least seven years.

title: Enterprise risk appetite
description: The board approves the enterprise risk appetite statement annually, covering credit, market, operational and compliance risk.

title: Policy governance
description: Risk policies are owned, reviewed at least every two years and approved by the relevant committee.

title: Annual compliance training
description: All employees complete annual compliance training on the code of conduct, privacy and reporting concerns.

title: Transaction monitoring
description: Customer transactions are monitored for suspicious activity and alerts are investigated within 30 days.

title: Customer due diligence
description: Customer identity is verified and risk-rated at onboarding and refreshed based on risk.

title: Access reviews
description: User access to critical systems is reviewed quarterly by system owners.

title: IT change management
description: Production changes to systems are approved, tested and logged.

title: Business continuity testing
description: Critical business processes have continuity plans tested annually.

title: Complaint management
description: Customer complaints are logged, investigated and trended monthly for root causes.

title: Marketing review
description: Customer-facing marketing materials are reviewed by compliance before publication.

title: UDAAP review
description: New products and customer communications are reviewed for unfair, deceptive or abusive practices.

title: Data quality monitoring
description: Critical data elements are monitored for completeness and accuracy with defined thresholds.

title: Financial reporting review
description: Quarterly financial statements are reviewed and certified by finance leadership.
